verdict.rationale: Bento's docs describe a dedicated transactional email capability for password resets, receipts, login codes and account notices. The same docs list transactional email alongside broadcasts and sequences as one of three email types. The CLI explicitly supports sending transactional emails next to creating broadcasts via the API, so one-to-one and marketing sends share one platform. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the transactional send API endpoint and payload (templating, personalization, delivery status), and independent or hands-on corroboration of transactional sending.
